Message.Name: Loan Transaction Available Quantity Message
Message.Description: Loan transaction available quantity public disclosure. Reports the available stock lending quantity for one issue (ISIN) in shares.

Field.Name: Issue Code
Field.Description: Standard Code (ISIN) of the issue. Workbook field name: 종목코드.

Field.Name: Business Code
Field.Description: Business code identifying the disclosure type. 001 = Loan transaction available quantity public disclosure. Workbook field name: 업무코드.

Field.Name: Available Lending Quantity
Field.Description: Available stock-lending quantity (10 ASCII digits). Workbook field name: 대주가능수량.

Field.Name: End Keyword
Field.Description: End of text sentinel (0xFF). Workbook field name: 정보분배메세지종료키워드.
